title: Typed name, rising phone, benefit chips
summary: The app name types itself on a warm glow, a phone rises over it, tilts and sprouts three one-word benefit chips, then a macro close-up and a side profile with shallow focus before a short call to action and the name again.
use_when: A consumer mobile app with one strong home screen to show
Vertical feeds where the product name must land in the first second
Three one-word benefits (speed, safety, trust) that fit on chips
A silent autoplay promo with a warm, friendly brand colour

look.type_style: rounded humanist sans, semibold, sentence case, normal tracking; name ~7 % of frame width per letter, ~4 % H; chips small medium-weight labels with a line icon

sfx.event: each letter of the name typed
benefit chip pops beside the phone
phone flies out and the macro slides in
zoom through the screen to the call to action

structure.shot: product name, one word, typed letter by letter, centred upper third; white bg with a warm glow rising from the bottom
structure.motion: typewriter 7 letters in 0.77 s (~9 cps, 0.00-0.77); warm glow fades up from white 0.00-0.50 (easings.inOutSine ~15 fr, ±0.25 s); name holds 15 fr

structure.shot: phone with the app home screen rises from below, covers the name and settles centred, face-on
structure.camera: drift: phone scale ~1.00 -> 1.04 over 1.0 s after landing
structure.motion: phone rises from y +45 % H to centre with a slight forward roll, springs.heavy ~22 fr (1.27-2.00, overshoot not measurable); name stays behind and is covered; holds 2.00-3.27 with a small upward drift

structure.shot: phone rolls into a 3/4 tilt (top leaning left) and shrinks; first benefit chip appears left of the phone
structure.camera: pull-out: phone width ~78 % -> 62 % of frame over 30 fr
structure.motion: phone rotates ~25 deg z and ~30 deg y, springs.heavy ~24 fr (3.27-4.00); chip 1 (icon + 1 word) pops at 3.77, springs.pop ~10 fr (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: three chips around the tilted phone: one top, one right, one left; hold, then the chips shrink
structure.camera: drift: phone glides right ~4 % W across the row
structure.motion: chips 2 and 3 pop together at 4.27 (springs.pop ~10 fr, ±0.25 s); hold 30 fr; from 5.27 chips scale down and fade 8 fr while the phone starts flipping back

structure.shot: phone flips flat and flies out the top edge; empty white frame; a blurred close-up of the phone slides in from the lower right
structure.camera: whip-pan up then a fast slide-in from bottom right
structure.motion: exit easings.inExpo ~10 fr (5.50-5.85); white with fading glow 6.00-6.27 (8 fr); close-up enters 6.27-6.73, easings.outExpo ~14 fr, heavy blur 14 px -> 6 px

structure.shot: macro of the phone's upper screen: header row and the two balance cards, tilted, shallow depth of field
structure.camera: push-in: slow creep ~1.00 -> 1.05 over 3.0 s, slight drift up-left; from 9.77 accelerates upward
structure.motion: rack-focus: the balance figures sharpen 6.73-7.50 (springs.heavy ~22 fr); near and far edges stay blurred; hold 7.50-9.50

structure.shot: camera travels down the screen past the list and the bottom tab bar; the phone leaves through the bottom, white frame
structure.camera: dolly down the screen ~1700 px/s @1920, easings.inExpo into the exit (10.27-10.77)
structure.motion: content slides up and out within 15 fr (±0.25 s); 10.77-11.00 empty white, glow off

structure.shot: side profile of the phone (buttons, frame edge) turns in from the left and settles in a 3/4 view, screen top on the right; soft focus
structure.camera: orbit-like turn ~60 deg y (11.00-11.77) then drift 1.00 -> 1.03 to 13.77
structure.motion: phone yaw from edge-on to 3/4, springs.heavy ~24 fr; screen out of focus (rack-focus, maxBlur ~6 px); warm glow returns 11.27-11.77

structure.shot: camera flies into the screen past the cards and list; everything blurs to the warm radial glow
structure.motion: screen layers blur 0 -> 20 px and fade, 14.22-14.77; glow fills the frame centre by 14.77

structure.shot: call to action, 3 words, white on a centred orange radial glow
structure.motion: line blur-in 15.00-15.27 (blur 12 px -> 0, easings.outExpo ~8 fr, ±0.25 s); holds 52 fr

structure.shot: product name in white on the same glow, then the glow and name fade to plain white
structure.motion: name replaces the call to action at 17.00 (blur-dissolve <= 8 fr, ±0.25 s); hold to 18.00; name and glow fade to white 18.00-18.77 (easings.inOutSine ~23 fr); white end 9 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: warm accent for the radial glow, fg, display font
params.content.name: product name, one word, typed at the start and shown at the end
params.content.screen: one tall home-screen screenshot (or a rebuilt screen) for the phone
params.content.chips: 3 benefits, one word each, with a line icon each
params.aspect: 9:16 native; 4:5 works with the chips moved inward

notes: No hard cuts: every scene change is carried by phone motion (rise, flip-out, slide-in, dolly-out, zoom-through). Name typing ~9 cps; phone rise lands by 2.00; chips 1 then 2+3 together, 0.50 s apart. Empty white frames at 6.00-6.27 and 10.77-11.00 act as breaths. Reference phone is a real 3D model; rebuild uses PhoneFrame tilt (2.5D). Proposed term (not in vocabulary): benefit-chip-pop. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
